api.spec: {name,on,value:0..1,params}; max two ordered specs per renderer
api.context: time seconds, frameId, bpm, bass/mid/treble/level/upfader 0..1, rate signed, optional position, reducedMotion, assetId, optional secondarySource
api.unsupported: WebGL2 required for slot FX; unsupported/undecoded/context-lost input throws. No placeholder fallback. readPixels is synchronous test/debug only.

routing.order: Raw input → two channel FX → channel overlays → transition → master overlays → two master FX
routing.referenceOrder: Unverified; this is an independent Open Play routing contract.
routing.scheduling: Phase-aligned performance.now clock toward30 ticks/s; caller tick required, including hidden-panel capture. Requested captureStream(30) and short observed rates do not establish sustained30fps.
routing.channelKeyBackground: Other raw channel source is supplied as secondarySource to channel alpha-key FX; independent routing choice.
routing.masterAudioContext: Master analyzer index4; master BPM currently follows left-channel BPM.
routing.transport: Independent positive-rate HTMLVideo playback; reverse/paused linked transport seeks to engine.position only when not already seeking and error exceeds1/60s; forward-playing drift threshold .25s. Retain last actual decoded raw frame while a same-asset seek is unavailable. Bounded real browser regressions executed; no frame-accurate AV sync claim.
routing.tempo: Linked channel BPM = nominal track BPM * abs(deck rate); independently declared audible-clock policy.

alpha.contract: Internal GPU source/history/slot filtering uses premultiplied RGBA; colour operations and final canvas/readPixels use straight RGB/alpha. Canvas2D source-over overlays. Exact vendor colour space/transfer is unknown.
alpha.executedRegression: 2x1 opaque-red/transparent-black resized4x1 matches Canvas2D, plus active Mirror and transition temporal read paths.

history.policy: Retain real upstream frames by timestamps; default2second span, bounded cadence; absent ages use oldest real frame. Frame Freeze/Frame Pulse hold full output resolution. Per-slot/effect state persists through parameter edits, resets on off/effect/source identity/currentSrc/assetId/reset; backward supplied time resets. Mixer uses monotonic render time, so deck seeking alone does not automatically imply history reset.

audioAnalysis.tap: Deck input before channel EQ and fader; master after master gain.
audioAnalysis.mapping: Square root of summed FFT-bin power, clamped 0..1; level is time-domain RMS. Not a recovered Serato mapping.
audioAnalysis.engineIntegration: Actual AudioEngine lazily creates pre-channel-EQ input taps and post-master-gain tap; silent sink keeps analysis active without adding source audio.
audioAnalysis.silence: Unavailable/suspended/disposed taps return zeros and audioAvailable:false.
